integrity: The ordinary full-dihedral quotient, not the Borel quotient or the rotation-only quotient, is the subject. Verification tests n=5..10 are finite corroboration, not an infinite-family proof.
scientific_limitations: The complete homotopy type is proved for all polygon sizes n>=5; the number of boundary components is given only for odd n. The genus/number for the cyclic quotient was published earlier and is not new. Distinct unindexed equivalent literature cannot be ruled out. Local quotient arguments are topological; no independently checked proof or human certification is claimed.
title: Dihedral quotients of polygonal real moment-angle surfaces are graphs up to homotopy
